$schema_note: Machine-readable form of evaluation-plan.md §3 + §8 (Stage 3, EV1/EV2; M-009 addendum EV3–EV6, 2026-09-24: EVAL-018…022 added, character gate reworded per S14, no threshold changed). Generic case schema from eval-framework.md extended for UI (viewport, accessibility_requirement) and for this project (method, threshold, related_tickets, runner). Authored Stage 6 (technical-plan.md A16). IDs, priorities and thresholds are stable; thresholds are never lowered to pass (EV2). M-009 ticket ids (TKT-69…91, tickets.md M-009 section) allocated at Stage 5, 2026-09-24. Read by scripts/eval.ts.

cases.input: Rendered / at 390 and 1440, first viewport only, 5 seconds
cases.expected_behavior: A recruiter reads: name · Senior PM · builds AI products · cares about user problems · actually builds · projects to explore
cases.expected_output: 6/6 checklist items legible without scrolling at both widths
failure_conditions: any item < 6/6 at either width
hero character does not match the locked character sheet (Variant B, 2026-09-23) or the style drifts (S14/EV4)
reads student/UI-kit/scrapbook rather than Senior PM
cases.method: Screenshot review against the 6-item checklist (Claude scores, Tushar confirms); evidence file evals/results/eval-001-<sha>.md

cases.input: Playwright journey / → /work → /work/[slug] → /about → resume → /contact
cases.expected_behavior: Every hop resolves; resume download returns 200 (or the labelled placeholder while resumeAvailable=false — production requires 200)
cases.expected_output: ≤ 6 clicks, every hop HTTP 200, /resume.pdf 200 on production

more than 6 clicks
resume 404 on production
cases.method: Playwright scripted journey (tests/e2e/eval-002.spec.ts) at 390 and 1440
